info.title: Field Shift API
info.summary: NASA Space Apps 2026 — Crop Rotation Decision-Support & Data Harmonization API
info.description:
**Field Shift API** — Decision-support backend for comparing crop rotation strategies using
NASA Earth observations, local soil and terrain data, and climate-conditioned risk scoring.

### Key Capabilities
- **Climate-Conditioned Rotation Engine (`/api/v1/rotations`)**: Evaluates baseline and alternative
  crop rotations across historical analog years matching the forecasted **ENSO** (`el_nino`,
  `la_nina`, `neutral`) and **IOD** (`positive`, `negative`, `neutral`) phases. Computes mean and
  worst-20% (**CVaR20**) irrigation demand, soil health heuristics, RUSLE slope erosion exposure,
  Pareto dominance, and pre-normalized `0-100` scores (`scores_100`).
- **Automatic AI-to-Database Persistence (`PostGIS`)**: Every AI comparison and NASA dataset
  ingestion automatically upserts structured records (`regions`, `parcels`, `crops`, `strategies`,
  `strategy_items`, `scenario_outcomes`, `evidence_cards`, `data_gaps`, `climate_year_labels`)
  into PostgreSQL/PostGIS when `DATABASE_URL` is configured, with graceful fallback in offline mode.
- **Agricultural Field Profiles (`/api/v1/fields`)**: Serves harmonized field profiles combining
  **NASA SRTM 30m** slope, **SoilGrids 250m / USDA SSURGO** soil properties, **NASA POWER** monthly
  normals, and **NASA HLS 30m NDVI** phenology curves.
- **NASA Data Ingestion, Zonal Harmonization & JSON Export (`/api/v1/climate`)**: Runs the A2
  pipeline to harmonize NASA POWER, GPM IMERG, SRTM, NOAA ONI/DMI, and HLS NDVI data, updates
  `datasets/manifest.yaml`, and exports optimized `scores.json` bundles with duplicate site-level
  gaps hoisted out.

### Response Envelope
Every endpoint returns a consistent `ApiResponse[T]` envelope:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { ... },
  "error": null,
  "meta": null
}
```

contact.name: Field Shift Team (A2 Data & Backend Engineering)

get.summary: List harmonized study sites and available crops
get.description: Returns all study sites (`banyumas`, `nevada_mason_valley`) that have harmonized NASA climate and terrain datasets ready in `PROCESSED_DIR`, including season slots, crop catalog keys, latest observed ENSO/IOD phases, and provenance sources.

200.description: List of harmonized study sites wrapped in ApiResponse

post.summary: Compare crop rotation strategies and persist AI results to PostGIS
post.description: Evaluates at least three crop rotation strategies (including the baseline rotation) against historical climate analog years matching the requested ENSO/IOD phase. Computes mean and worst-20% (CVaR20) irrigation demand, soil health heuristics, RUSLE slope-adjusted erosion exposure, Pareto dominance, and normalized 0-100 scores. Whenever a PostgreSQL/PostGIS database session is configured, the AI comparison output (strategies, sequence items, scenario outcomes, evidence cards, and data gaps) is automatically upserted into the database.

200.description: Ranked crop rotation strategies, executive summary, and DB sync status

400.description: Invalid domain parameters (e.g., all zero weights or invalid crop)

404.description: Requested site or field_id was not found

422.description: Validation error or missing processed dataset files

get.summary: List agricultural field profiles for a study site
get.description: Returns all harmonized agricultural field profiles (`fields.json`) for the given study site, serialized in `camelCase` to match `FieldProfile` in the React frontend. Includes SRTM elevation/slope, SoilGrids/SSURGO soil properties, 12-month NASA POWER climate normals, HLS 30m NDVI phenology time-series, and explicit data-availability confidence disclosure. Automatically syncs parcel geometries to PostGIS when active.

200.description: List of field profiles in camelCase

422.description: Missing or invalid field profile dataset

get.summary: Get a single agricultural field profile by ID
get.description: Returns one harmonized field profile (`FieldProfileOut`) by its unique `field_id` (e.g., `banyumas-karangrau-01`, `banyumas-sumbang-02`, `banyumas-rawalo-03`) and syncs its parcel boundary and soil record to PostGIS when active.

404.description: Site or field_id was not found

422.description: Missing or invalid field profile dataset

post.summary: Ingest & harmonize NASA datasets, export JSON, and sync to PostGIS
post.description: Runs the A2 NASA data ingestion and zonal harmonization pipeline for the requested site (`banyumas` or `nevada_mason_valley`). Generates harmonized seasonal climate indicators (`NASA POWER`, `GPM IMERG`, `NOAA ONI/DMI`), SRTM terrain slope shares, field profiles (`SoilGrids 250m` / `SSURGO` + `HLS 30m NDVI`), and precomputed `scores.json` with duplicate site-level gaps hoisted out. Also updates `datasets/manifest.yaml` and pushes `Region`, `DataSource`, and `ClimateYearLabel` records to PostgreSQL/PostGIS when `DATABASE_URL` is configured.

200.description: Ingestion summary, JSON optimization report, and database sync status

get.summary: Get harmonized NASA climate indicators and ENSO/IOD summary
get.description: Returns the harmonized NASA POWER / IMERG seasonal climate indicators, latest ENSO/IOD phase outlook, SRTM steep-slope share, and per-phase climate averages for the specified study site. By default `compact=true` omits the raw 1991-2024 row list so the JSON response stays concise and fast; pass `compact=false` to include every historical seasonal record.

get.summary: Export optimized precomputed JSON bundle and payload audit report
get.description: Generates and returns the optimized JSON export bundle (`scores.json` contract) across all ENSO phases (`el_nino`, `neutral`, `la_nina`), along with a `JsonQualityReportOut` showing raw vs optimized byte size, percentage reduction, and how repeated site-level data gaps were hoisted into `shared_site_gaps`.
